description: Resume work paused at the same scope: a task returns to in_progress, a participant can be assigned tasks again, a workspace returns to active.

participant_uri.description: Whose work to resume, when scope is 'participant'. Must be a workspace member.

scope.description: What the resume applies to. 'task' returns a paused task to 'in_progress'; a task that is not paused is refused with -32061. 'participant' allows that member to be assigned tasks again. 'workspace' returns the workspace to active.
